summary: Regression check for mobile horizontal overflow fix on SignalVelocityChart legend. All three checks PASS: mobile (390) and tablet (768) no overflow, strike rings still render correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor (non-blocking): Recharts logs 'width(-1) and height(-1)' warning on initial render at 390px viewport. Chart still renders correctly after layout settles, but consider setting an explicit minWidth/minHeight on ResponsiveContainer to silence the warning.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile overflow fix verified at 390 and 768 viewports. The min-w-0 + truncate + max-w-[10rem] sm:max-w-[18rem] on legend button title span successfully eliminated the 424px overflow seen in iteration_8. Strike rings remain at 6 for default 24H range.
